title: Grusch's secondhand spaceship testimony explained as misidentified test drone

tellings.quote: just take the case of Grush saying I talked to somebody who interacted with this spaceship. He told me it was a spaceship.

related.note: Shermer takes Grusch's congressional testimony, that a witness told him about a spaceship, and explains it as a misidentified test drone. That is a different core claim about the same testimony.

plain: When David Grusch, a witness who testified to the US Congress in 2023, said there were spaceships, he was only repeating what someone else told him, and that person may simply have seen a test drone and taken it for something else. That is the argument of Michael Shermer, presented as America's best-known skeptic, in a debate with Michels. He puts it as Grusch saying, "I talked to somebody who interacted with this spaceship. He told me it was a spaceship," and his point is that secondhand claims like this cannot prove anything.
